Coca-Cola has been a refreshing beverage for 125 years but it s more than that. It also is a delicious ingredient for cooking and baking. The Coca-Cola Refreshing Recipes cookbook offers more than 90 recipes that incorporate the flavor of Coca-Cola in appetizers, entrees and side dishes, cakes and pies, and more.Coca-Cola Refreshing Recipes starts with an introduction, The Chronicle of Coca-Cola, and then presents these five sections:??Soups and Starters. Includes recipes for Gazpacho with Coca-Cola Reduction, Coca-Cola Chili, and Twin Cheese Dip??Entrees: Beef and Pork. Includes recipes for Sweet and Sour Glazed Beef Kebobs, Coca-Cola Roast, and Cherry Pork Medallions with Coca-Cola??Entrees: Poultry and Seafood. Includes recipes for Bayou Jambalaya, Country Captain Chicken, and Seared Scallops with Coca-Cola Glaze??Sides Dishes, Sauces, and Salads. Includes recipes for Braised Brussels Sprouts with Caramelized Onions, Uncle Joe s Baked Beans, and Coca-Cola Mashed Potatoes??Desserts. Includes recipes for Mocha Coca-Cola Float, Fudgey Coca-Cola Brownies, and Molten Lava Coca-Cola Cakes
